A '''Bunkurd Reclamation System''' was a type of sewer system. It was in use in the few parts of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] that had sewer systems around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The old, broken-down, and leaky state of Mos Eisley's Bunkurd Sewer Systems caused [[Falynn Sandskimmer]] to contract [[Bunkurd Sewer Disorder]] at some time when she lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
